title: Tracecat 1.3.1
body_markdown:
## Infrastructure


- fix(infra): Pass` TRACECAT__DB_ENCRYPTION_ALGORITHM` and` TRACECAT__DB_ENCRYPTION_PREVIOUS_KEYS` through in Compose ([8310517](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/commit/831051785a6b98b9f8e6df1f14ba1718470509db) )


Set` TRACECAT__DB_ENCRYPTION_ALGORITHM=aes256gcm` in` .env` before the first` docker compose up` to store credentials with AES-256-GCM. A` docker-compose.override.yml` is no longer needed. See[Database encryption](https://docs.tracecat.com/self-hosting/security#database-encryption) .
